summary: Athena Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly report for the period ended September 30, 2026, the standard disclosure equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q for this Canadian foreign private issuer. The filing is routine financial reporting: balance sheet and equity roll-forward data, project carrying values (Excelsior Springs, Laird Lake, Forester), and notes on option and net smelter return arrangements, including the Bounty Gold option on Laird Lake. No transaction, tender, campaign, or board change is announced. No special-situation event or deal terms are present; no risk-arb angle applies.
